deck: Use case: game production sprite. Asset type: one isolated modular battlefield pedestal for a fantasy card game, NOT a whole UI screen. Orthographic top-down with only a very shallow sculpted bevel; no isometric camera, no perspective building. Tall portrait footprint width:height 110:170, centered, fill most of the canvas with a small transparent margin. Match one coherent polished hand-painted forest arena DNA: dark mossy stone, rich deep jade and emerald inset, restrained aged warm gold bevel trim, tiny leaf/rune accents, crisp readable silhouette and calm detailed textures. This will display at only110x170referencepixels, so keep forms bold and uncluttered. Inside there must be a broad EMPTY DARK RECESSED INSET: upper roughly65% unobstructed to receive a card-back icon rendered later in code; lower roughly23% is a quiet flat EMPTY count well, subtly separated with a narrow gold stone seam. Do not draw the icon or any cards. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no heroes, no printed labels, no HUD, no surrounding scenery. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the isolated stone object. Do not paint a flat rectangle background or giant cast shadow. One single component only, not an atlas and not multiple panels. DECK VARIANT: rectangular stone pedestal with two shallow stacked stone ledges along its bottom edge, neat gold corner braces, a little moss at outer bottom corners, restrained tiny jade rune glow. Functional empty inset stays large and legible. No actual stack of cards, no book.
